title: Separability rigidity of Gaussian states under positive domination
summary: We prove a separability rigidity theorem for finite-mode Gaussian states. Let $ρ_G$ be Gaussian and let $\mathcal I$ be a fixed partition of the modes. If $ρ_G$ dominates a nonzero positive operator $T$ that is separable across $\mathcal I$, $0\neq T\preccurlyeq ρ_G$, then $ρ_G$ itself is separable across $\mathcal I$. The dominated operator is arbitrary and need not be Gaussian. The theorem has three applications. First, any Gaussian channel admitting a nonzero entanglement-breaking completely positive subchannel is itself entanglement breaking, even when that subchannel is non-Gaussian.…
